# Dispatched-by-string names with no publisher in the shipped tree, carried by
# the MSUF static checks (ratchet: this list may only shrink). Each name is
# handed to a CallGlobal-style dispatcher or sits in a dispatch name list, and
# nothing in the main/Options tree ever assigns it, so the call is a no-op. Fix
# the name (or delete the dead call) and remove its line; a new unpublished
# dispatch fails the check instead of being added here.
